excerpts.text: One special Friday Yusuf's father gets dressed before a flicker of light brightens the sky. He pulls on his heavy weatherproof jacket and the green woolen cap that covers his ears. He waves his boy goodbye. Yusuf's eyes brighten when Papa says, "Today is the day I will catch a fish and bring a gift home for you."
excerpts.question: Summarise what the father promises Yusuf. Describe what makes a gift meaningful.

excerpts.text: All day long Yusuf looks at the sky. It is bright and clear and windless. A fish and a gift! What will Papa bring home from the sea? Sometimes he brings a beautiful shell. Sometimes he brings a jewel green bottle rinsed by the waves.
excerpts.question: Explain what Yusuf is waiting for. Tell a friend about a gift you would like.

excerpts.text: The men pull the boat in and coil up the cables. A hard white triangle catches Papa's finger. "Whaaat? Whaaat? Whaaat?" cry the gulls. "What did you bring back for Yusuf?" As the sun goes down, Papa answers the gulls. "A lucky shark tooth for my boy." At home Yusuf holds his gift up to the stars.
excerpts.question: Retell how the father finds a gift. Explain why an inexpensive gift can matter more than an expensive one.
